doc_title_en: Management Initiatives to Realize Capital-Cost- and Stock-Price-Aware Operations
doc_title_jp: 資本コストや株価を意識した経営の実現に向けた対応について

key_facts.reason_jp: 資本コストを上回る利益創出のため、ROE10%台回復とPBR1倍超の早期実現を目指す

summary_en: Current ROE –40.7% (FY3/26), PBR 0.75x; cost of capital 5.17%. Targets: PBR >1.0, ROE 10%+. Dividend policy shift FY3/27: DOE 3.0% basis, semi-annual (interim+final) vs. annual. Actions: domestic profitability (store restructuring, cost control); China optimization (asset transfers, concentration); IR expansion.
summary_jp: 現状：ROE –40.7%（FY3/26）、PBR 0.75倍、株主資本コスト5.17%。目標：PBR1倍超、ROE10%台。FY3/27より配当方針転換：DOE3.0%基準、年2回（中間・期末）。国内事業効率化、中国事業最適化、IR強化を推進。
tag_en: Capital Cost Management Update – ROE 10%+ target, PBR >1.0 goal, DOE 3.0% dividend policy
tag_jp: 資本コスト意識経営 – ROE10%台回復目標、PBR1倍超達成目標、DOE3.0%配当方針転換
